## Note on scope

This lists what the course *defines*, not what v1 *activates*. Owner decision D2 covers the full catalogue, satisfied at `registered` — which costs nothing. A requirement reaching `specified` needs an algorithm spec and declared parameters; reaching `active` additionally needs parameter values with provenance and golden vectors (`COMPONENT_REGISTRY_SPEC.md` §3).
